messages.subject: Time recording overdue — week ending 6 February
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our records show 9.5 hours unposted for the week ending 6 February. Please complete your time entries by end of day Tuesday so we can issue February bills on schedule. Matters with WIP over 30 days are flagged for partner review.

Regards,
Accounts | Whitfield Carter LLP
